data.exact_reserve_text: The prior year development is calculated from the 'Estimate of cumulative gross claims incurred' table on page 17 by comparing the current estimate for each underwriting year (2021 and prior) to its estimate from the previous development period.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 1.890 million in 2023, representing a 10.14% reduction relative to the opening gross claims outstanding. This favorable development was derived from the claims development triangle, reflecting a reduction in the estimated ultimate claims for the 2019, 2020, and 2021 underwriting years. No specific events or detailed causal factors were explicitly stated for this movement beyond general claims development patterns.
raw_causal_phrases: The principal assumption underlying the liability estimates is that the future claims development will follow a similar pattern to past claims development experience.

The uncertainty associated with the ultimate claims experience of an underwriting year is greatest when the underwriting year is at an early stage of development and the margin for future experience potentially being more adverse than assumed is at its highest.
As claims develop, and the ultimate cost of the claims becomes more certain, the relative level of margin should decrease.
data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure was calculated from the gross claims development triangle as no explicit prior year movement note or narrative figure was available. The syndicate states it has no reinsurance exposure, implying gross and net figures are identical for claims outstanding and movements.
